name: Fidelidade - Companhia de Seguros
note: Fidelidade's own shareholders page lists Fosun Group (through Millennium Gain Limited) at 84.9892% and state-owned Caixa Geral de Depósitos (CGD) at 15%. The CGD stake is a passive minority interest; parent of hospital-da-luz (Luz Saude, where Fidelidade retains 60% after Macquarie bought 40% in Sep 2025).
